content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect modules with varying voltage levels in the following sequence: [product_name] 230RCE -> [product_name] DM16 230R -> [product_name] AM2 RTD -> [product_name] AM2 RQ -> [product_name] DM8 24 // [user_name]
Yes. The analog expansion modules provide galvanic isolation for the bus.

Thanks for the quick reply. I assumed it might be possible, but the manual didn't make it entirely clear. I prefer to double-check than risk damaging equipment. It could be helpful to include more information about galvanic isolation in the manual. // [user_name]
However, according to the second table, all expansion modules connect to analog expansion modules, except DM230.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion revolves around the compatibility and safety of combining different module types with various voltage levels, emphasizing the role of galvanic isolation provided by analog expansion modules. Documentation is seen as lacking in detail regarding electrical isolation and some module combinations, pushing users to seek confirmation from the community.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect manuals to provide clear and complete information about electrical isolation and compatibility, ensuring they can make safe decisions when connecting modules with different voltages.
